description: Routes INTO one system, most stable first: (1) the vendor's official MCP server — URL/auth/local command verbatim, with source and date (never a URL found by search); (2) official API key or OAuth issuing; (3) file/screen (renkeimap_pair). detail:"full" adds the procedure and evidence. Read-only; no keys or values.

detail.description: short (default) or full — full adds the issuing procedure, minimal scope and evidence

slug.description: system slug (from renkeimap_find_system), or a suite id as renkeimap_pair returns it (a.slug / b.slug) — then the answer lists each public member

name: renkeimap_connect
